subject.title: fix(openai): harden Codex OAuth callback cleanup

question: Should OpenAI OAuth token requests receive this permanent hostname-scoped exception for RFC 2544 and IPv6 unique-local fake-IP resolutions?
rationale: The exception may be necessary for common proxy fake-IP stacks, but it deliberately changes outbound-network policy and cannot be accepted from unit wiring or stale live proof alone.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Keep the narrow auth.openai.com policy after a live fake-IP proxy run proves OAuth succeeds and unrelated private destinations remain blocked.

options.title: Split the security change
options.body: Land callback, parsing, and prompt cleanup separately while holding the fake-IP SSRF exception for dedicated network review.

options.title: Reject the exception
options.body: Remove the address-range relaxation and retain only the non-security OAuth cleanup changes.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow auth.openai.com policy after a live fake-IP proxy run proves OAuth succeeds and unrelated private destinations remain blocked.
